rationaleAppend: isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 30:19 lᵉqôl zaʿăqeḵā 'at the sound of your outcry' (ASV 'at the voice of thy cry'), the cry of Zion answered by YHWH.
isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 30:22 pᵉsîlê ḵaspeḵā 'your carved images of silver', beside massēḵaṯ zᵉhāḇeḵā 'your molten image of gold'.
isaiah-woh wave I-5: hāʾăḏāmāh 'the ground' at Isa 30:23 (twice) and 30:24 ('that work the ground'); the ʾāḏām side of the pair does not occur.

isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 30:7 applies the monster name Rahab to Egypt ('therefore I have called her Rahab who sits still'; ASV). The line names the monster under overlay rahab-sea-monster-name-isaiah; the cluster is cited in commentary only (with Ps 87:4, where Rahab is also a name for Egypt), and no term of the myth enters the line.

isaiah-woh wave I-5: Isa 30:33 tāp̄teh (a form of tōp̄eṯ) 'a Topheth' is a Hebrew Bible node of the Hinnom/Topheth chain; Targum Jonathan renders it gêhinnām (checked on Sefaria, 2026-11-26), the step toward the later name. The Isaiah line keeps the place name 'a Topheth' (ASV) and does not use 'Gehenna'; the entry's wohChoice continues to govern 1 En 27 only.
